name: services/statements/user_status
description: Check if user has all required declarations and is allowed to use USOS.
brief_description: Check if user has all required declarations and is allowed to use USOS.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following format:

  • allowed - boolean, true if user has all required declarations and is allowed to use USOS.
  • reason - reason why user is not allowed to use USOS.
    Possible values:
    • awaiting_declarations - user has not made all declarations
    • no_pledge - user has not pledged on any active programmes
    • null - user is allowed to use USOS
